prompt.en: How old is the tradition of ordered liberty that Canadians have inherited?
prompt.fr: Quel âge a la tradition de liberté ordonnée dont les Canadiens ont hérité?

explanation.en: The sources of Canadian law together give Canadians a tradition of ordered liberty that is about 800 years old, going back to Magna Carta in 1215.
explanation.fr: Les sources du droit canadien donnent ensemble aux Canadiens une tradition de liberté ordonnée vieille d'environ 800 ans, qui remonte à la Magna Carta de 1215.

source.quote: Together, these secure for Canadians an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England (also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms)

verification.evidence: Together, these secure for Canadians an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215
